name: defycard.com
description: Site-facing skills for AI agents on DefyCard — independent crypto-card comparison hub. Read-only; no auth, no protected APIs, no MCP server.

skills.name: search-articles
skills.description: Keyword search across DefyCard's published articles. The skill reads /sitemap-0.xml, filters URLs by substring or regex, and returns ranked matches.

skills.name: browse-by-bucket
skills.description: List articles by content bucket (hub, compare, reviews, how-to, geo, tools, learn, help, faq, news, for). Sourced from the sitemap.

skills.name: fetch-article
skills.description: Fetch the full article body in HTML or Markdown by slug. Use Accept: text/markdown for the markdown form (no nav, no ads).

absent.oauth-discovery: No protected APIs on this domain. /.well-known/openid-configuration intentionally omitted (publishing fake OIDC endpoints would mislead agents).
absent.mcp-server-card: No MCP server runs on defycard.com. /.well-known/mcp/server-card.json intentionally omitted.
